script: Stalin once invented a murder plot to justify killing his own doctors. In 1953, Stalin's government announced that a group of the country's top physicians, most of them Jewish, had been secretly poisoning Soviet leaders for years on foreign orders. Newspapers ran the story daily, doctors were arrested and tortured into false confessions, and a nationwide purge began. But here's the part nobody mentions, there was no actual plot at all, Stalin needed a new enemy to justify tightening his grip before he died. Then Stalin suddenly died himself, just weeks later, and the entire case collapsed overnight. Every accused doctor was quietly released, and the government admitted the whole conspiracy had been fabricated from nothing. Stalin invented a murder plot to justify a purge, and died before he ever got to use it.
